comment: Settlement levels (GDD 5.3) and how a new tribe starts. population: [min, max] people. storage: one shared warehouse capacity in units (CORE simplified, GDD 4.3); anything above it is lost. mobile: the settlement can move (nomad camp). abandonedYears: an empty settlement stays abandoned this long (buildings standing, can be taken over at once), then it is ruins until ruinsUntilYears after abandonment, then it disappears (GDD 5.5, CORE simplified: two states; archaeology is a later module). Bigger settlements of more advanced civilizations last longer; single buildings will add their own material durability when buildings arrive. abandonment.claimYears: the former owner keeps a claim this long. carrying.perPerson: units of goods one person carries when a group moves, splits, leaves or plunders; the carry_capacity_percent effect (pack animals, carts, boats from technologies) raises it. Years are converted by the turn length of the era. requires (optional, stage 3f): the technology a camp needs to settle down as this level (GDD 5.3: a village needs agriculture). settle.minPeople: a camp needs this many people to settle.
